replies.body: Updated in 6afc7066. The existing Vert.x 5 HTTP client integration tests passed; CodeQL skipped analysis because the Java database was too large.

threads.body: The existing Vert.x 5 tests do not check response collectability after an HTTP/1.x mid-body disconnect, so they would not detect a recurrence of this retention bug. Add an agent integration test with `otel.javaagent.experimental.field-injection.enabled=false` that receives headers, disconnects before the body completes, drops application references, and verifies that the response becomes collectible. Assert the exported peer address and port as well to cover telemetry preservation on this path.
